items.zh: 生成式人工智能的快速普及引发了广泛讨论。它能显著提高写作和编程的效率，也可能被用于制造虚假信息。因此，如何在鼓励创新与防范风险之间找到平衡，成为各国共同面对的难题。
items.en: The rapid spread of generative artificial intelligence has triggered widespread debate. It can significantly improve the efficiency of writing and programming, but it may also be used to produce disinformation. Finding a balance between encouraging innovation and preventing risks has therefore become a shared challenge for all countries.
tip: generative AI 生成式人工智能，为通用译法
be used to do 被用来做，注意与 used to do 区分
Finding ... 动名词短语作主语

items.zh: 平台经济的迅速扩张带来了新的监管问题。大型平台掌握着海量数据和流量入口，容易形成市场支配地位。近年来，中国加强了反垄断执法，要求平台不得强迫商家「二选一」。
items.en: The rapid expansion of the platform economy has created new regulatory problems. Large platforms control massive amounts of data and gateways to online traffic, which makes it easy for them to gain a dominant market position. In recent years, China has strengthened antitrust enforcement, requiring platforms not to force merchants to choose between them.
tip: gateway to traffic 流量入口
which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前句
requiring ... 现在分词作伴随状语

items.zh: 社会保障体系的覆盖面不断扩大。目前，基本医疗保险覆盖十三亿多人，基本养老保险参保人数超过十亿。不过，不同群体之间的待遇差距仍然明显，制度整合仍需推进。
items.en: The coverage of the social security system has kept expanding. Basic medical insurance now covers more than 1.3 billion people, and the number of people enrolled in basic pension insurance exceeds one billion. However, gaps in benefits between different groups remain obvious, and institutional integration still needs to be advanced.
tip: coverage 覆盖面，为社保类文本核心词
be enrolled in 参加（保险、课程）
institutional integration 制度整合

items.zh: 全国碳排放权交易市场于 2021 年上线。发电企业需要为超额排放购买配额，减排效率高的企业则可以出售剩余配额获利。这一机制试图用市场价格引导企业减排。
items.en: The national carbon emissions trading market was launched in 2021. Power companies must buy allowances for emissions beyond their quota, while companies that cut emissions efficiently can profit by selling surplus allowances. The mechanism seeks to guide companies towards lower emissions through market prices.
tip: emissions trading market 碳排放权交易市场
beyond one's quota 超出配额
guide sb towards 引导某人走向

items.zh: 芯片是现代工业的基础，也是国际竞争的焦点。中国每年进口芯片的金额超过石油，对外依存度较高。提升本土设计和制造能力，需要长期的基础研究投入和人才培养。
items.en: Chips are the foundation of modern industry and a focus of international competition. China spends more on imported chips each year than on oil, which reflects a high degree of dependence on foreign supply. Strengthening domestic design and manufacturing capacity requires long-term investment in basic research and talent development.
tip: spend on 在……上花费，比较对象用 than on oil
which 引导定语从句，指代前句事实
domestic 本土的，与 foreign 相对

items.zh: 科研评价体系正在从「唯论文」转向更加多元的标准。一些高校不再把论文数量作为晋升的唯一依据，而是更看重成果的实际贡献。这一改革能否真正落地，取决于配套制度的完善。
items.en: The research evaluation system is shifting from a sole focus on published papers to more diverse criteria. Some universities no longer treat the number of papers as the only basis for promotion and attach greater weight to the real impact of research. Whether this reform can be truly implemented depends on the improvement of supporting institutions.
tip: shift from A to B 从 A 转向 B
attach weight to 重视，weight 前可加 greater
Whether ... 主语从句，谓语用 depends

items.zh: 养老服务需求快速增长，传统的家庭养老模式难以独力承担。社区养老和机构养老因此迅速发展，但专业护理人员严重不足。如何吸引年轻人进入这一行业，是亟待解决的问题。
items.en: Demand for elderly care is growing rapidly, and the traditional model of family-based care can no longer bear the burden alone. Community-based and institutional care have therefore developed quickly, yet professional carers are in serious shortage. How to attract young people into the industry is an urgent problem to be solved.
tip: bear the burden 承担负担
be in shortage 短缺，也可用 be in short supply
an urgent problem to be solved 不定式被动作定语

items.zh: 光伏产业的成本在过去十年下降了约九成。中国已成为全球最大的光伏组件生产国，产品出口到两百多个国家和地区。但产能过剩和价格战也给行业带来压力。
items.en: The cost of solar power has fallen by about 90 percent over the past decade. China has become the world's largest producer of photovoltaic modules, exporting its products to more than 200 countries and regions. Overcapacity and price wars, however, have also put pressure on the industry.
tip: fall by 下降幅度用 by，下降到用 to
photovoltaic module 光伏组件
overcapacity 产能过剩，为经济类高频词

items.zh: 中国影视作品正在加快「出海」步伐。一些剧集通过流媒体平台进入东南亚和非洲市场，受到当地观众欢迎。不过，文化差异和翻译质量仍是影响传播效果的关键因素。
items.en: Chinese films and television dramas are speeding up their going-global efforts. Some series have entered Southeast Asian and African markets through streaming platforms and are well received by local audiences. Cultural differences and translation quality, however, remain key factors affecting how widely they spread.
tip: going-global efforts 出海，用引号词转译
be well received 受到欢迎，为固定被动结构
how widely they spread 名词性从句作宾语

items.zh: 中小企业贡献了中国一半以上的税收和八成以上的城镇就业。但它们获得的银行贷款比例却明显偏低。近年来，政府推动普惠金融，希望缓解中小企业融资难的问题。
items.en: Small and medium-sized enterprises contribute more than half of China's tax revenue and over 80 percent of urban employment. Yet the share of bank loans they receive is markedly low. In recent years, the government has promoted inclusive finance in the hope of easing their difficulty in obtaining credit.
tip: contribute 占（比例），主语为企业
the share ... they receive 省略 that 的定语从句
in the hope of doing 希望做

items.zh: 储能技术是可再生能源大规模应用的关键。风能和太阳能发电受天气影响，容易出现波动。只有把多余的电储存起来，电网才能保持稳定运行。
items.en: Energy storage technology is key to the large-scale use of renewable energy. Power generated from wind and solar sources fluctuates with the weather. Only by storing surplus electricity can the grid maintain stable operation.
tip: be key to 是……的关键，to 为介词
fluctuate with 随……波动
Only by ... can ... 部分倒装结构

items.zh: 「共同富裕」并不意味着平均分配。政策的目标是扩大中等收入群体，提高低收入者的收入水平。为此，需要在教育、就业和税收等方面进行系统性改革。
items.en: Common prosperity does not mean equal distribution. The goal of the policy is to expand the middle-income group and raise the incomes of low-income earners. Achieving this requires systematic reform in areas such as education, employment and taxation.
tip: common prosperity 共同富裕，为固定译法
middle-income group 中等收入群体
Achieving this 动名词作主语，回指上句

items.zh: 出国留学的人数在经历多年增长后趋于平稳。与此同时，回国发展的留学生比例不断上升。国内就业市场的竞争加剧，使「海归」的光环逐渐淡化。
items.en: The number of students studying abroad has levelled off after years of growth. Meanwhile, the proportion of overseas graduates returning home has kept rising. Intensified competition in the domestic job market has gradually dimmed the lustre of a foreign degree.
tip: level off 趋于平稳，为图表类高频动词
the proportion of ... has kept rising 主谓一致
dim the lustre 使光环淡化，为比喻表达

items.zh: 国际传播能力的提升，不仅取决于语言水平，也取决于叙事方式。生硬的宣传难以引起共鸣，真实具体的故事更容易被接受。因此，讲述者需要了解受众的文化背景和关注点。
items.en: Improving international communication capacity depends not only on language proficiency but also on narrative approach. Rigid propaganda rarely strikes a chord, whereas authentic and specific stories are more readily accepted. Storytellers therefore need to understand their audiences' cultural backgrounds and concerns.
tip: depend on 取决于
strike a chord 引起共鸣，为固定搭配
whereas 表对比，连接两个并列分句

items.zh: 绿色金融为环保项目提供了新的资金来源。银行发行绿色债券，把募集的资金投向清洁能源和污染治理。但如何界定「绿色」，仍需统一的标准和第三方认证。
items.en: Green finance provides a new source of funding for environmental projects. Banks issue green bonds and channel the proceeds into clean energy and pollution control. Yet defining what counts as green still requires unified standards and third-party certification.
tip: channel ... into 把……投入，动词用法
proceeds 募集资金，常用复数
what counts as green 名词性从句作宾语

items.zh: 医疗保险的异地结算让流动人口受益。过去，患者需要先垫付费用再回原籍报销；如今，在就医地就能直接结算。这一改变看似技术问题，实则涉及制度衔接。
items.en: Cross-regional settlement of medical insurance benefits migrant populations. In the past, patients had to pay upfront and then claim reimbursement back in their home province; today they can settle bills directly where they receive treatment. What looks like a technical change actually involves linking different institutional systems.
tip: cross-regional settlement 异地结算
pay upfront 垫付，claim reimbursement 报销
What looks like ... 主语从句，谓语用 involves

items.zh: 自动驾驶技术正从试验场走向城市道路。部分城市已允许无人驾驶出租车在特定区域运营。但事故责任如何认定、数据如何监管，相关法律仍不完善。
items.en: Self-driving technology is moving from test tracks onto city roads. Some cities now allow robotaxis to operate in designated areas. Yet the law remains incomplete on how to assign liability in accidents and how to regulate data.
tip: robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车，为行业通用词
assign liability 认定责任
remains incomplete on ... 在……方面仍不完善

items.zh: 极端天气事件的频率和强度都在上升。城市排水系统在暴雨面前显得脆弱，内涝造成严重损失。建设「海绵城市」，通过透水路面和绿地蓄水，成为应对之策。
items.en: Extreme weather events are increasing in both frequency and intensity. Urban drainage systems appear fragile in the face of heavy rain, and waterlogging causes serious losses. Building sponge cities, which absorb water through permeable pavements and green spaces, has become a response.
tip: in frequency and intensity 在频率和强度上
in the face of 面对，比 facing 更书面
which 引导定语从句，指代 sponge cities

items.zh: 直播带货在短短几年内成长为万亿级市场。主播通过实时演示和互动促成交易，缩短了消费者的决策过程。但虚假宣传和售后缺失等问题也随之出现。
items.en: Livestream shopping has grown into a trillion-yuan market in just a few years. Hosts close deals through live demonstrations and interaction, shortening consumers' decision-making process. Yet problems such as false advertising and poor after-sales service have emerged alongside it.
tip: livestream shopping 直播带货
close a deal 促成交易
alongside it 随之，it 指前句现象

items.zh: 电子竞技已进入亚运会正式比赛项目。职业选手的训练强度不亚于传统运动员，但职业寿命往往更短。如何保障退役选手的转型，是行业需要面对的问题。
items.en: Esports has become an official event at the Asian Games. Professional players train as intensively as traditional athletes, yet their careers are often shorter. How to support retired players in changing careers is a problem the industry has to face.
tip: official event 正式比赛项目
as intensively as 与……同等强度
support sb in doing 支持某人做

items.zh: 住房问题牵动着大城市的年轻人。房价收入比居高不下，租房成为多数人的现实选择。近年来，保障性租赁住房的建设规模不断扩大，试图缓解这一矛盾。
items.en: Housing concerns young people in big cities. With the price-to-income ratio remaining high, renting has become the realistic choice for most of them. In recent years, the construction of subsidised rental housing has been scaled up in an attempt to ease the tension.
tip: price-to-income ratio 房价收入比
With ... remaining high 独立主格结构
be scaled up 规模扩大，被动语态

items.zh: 开源软件支撑着现代数字基础设施，却常由少数志愿者维护。一旦关键项目出现安全漏洞，影响会迅速扩散。如何为开源生态提供可持续的资金支持，已成为业界关注的话题。
items.en: Open-source software underpins modern digital infrastructure, yet it is often maintained by a small number of volunteers. Once a critical project develops a security flaw, the impact spreads quickly. How to provide sustainable funding for the open-source ecosystem has become a topic of concern in the industry.
tip: underpin 支撑，比 support 更强调基础性
Once 引导条件状语从句，主句用一般现在时
funding 资金，不可数

items.zh: 高校学科调整的速度正在加快。一些传统专业因就业市场萎缩而被撤销，人工智能、集成电路等方向则不断增设。这种调整反映了产业结构的变迁，也给学生选择专业带来不确定性。
items.en: The adjustment of university disciplines is accelerating. Some traditional majors have been discontinued as their job markets shrink, while programmes in artificial intelligence and integrated circuits keep being added. Such adjustments reflect changes in the industrial structure and bring uncertainty to students choosing their majors.
tip: discontinue a major 撤销专业
while 表对比，连接两个分句
bring uncertainty to 给……带来不确定性
